use_case_title: Unified Data Foundation for In Store Operations
description_and_problem_statement:
Problem Statement: Retailers often struggle with inefficient inventory management, which can result in stockouts or overstocking. Poor staff engagement and high turnover contribute to a lackluster customer experience, and an inability to innovate can leave retailers struggling to meet evolving customer expectations. Disorganized store layouts and high operational costs are also significant challenges.

Description: A unified data foundation is crucial for a connected store, as it provides a single source of truth for all data related to customers, products, and operations.
key_personas: Chief Operating Officer, VP of Customer Experience, Head of Customer Service, Director of Contact Center Operations
customer_user_journeys: As a store manager, I want a single dashboard that shows me real-time sales, inventory, and staffing levels so I can make immediate, informed decisions. As a Chief Operating Officer (COO), I want to break down data silos across my organization to get a holistic view of the business and uncover inefficiencies.
how_it_works_narrative: This foundational solution centralizes all of a retailer's disparate data—from POS systems, e-commerce platforms, supply chain logs, and marketing campaigns—into BigQuery. With this single source of truth, a store manager can access a Looker dashboard that visualizes sales trends, in-store traffic patterns, and inventory levels in real time. They can easily see which products are selling best, identify staffing gaps during peak hours, and understand the true impact of a recent promotion. This breaks down data silos and empowers leaders at every level to make data-driven decisions that improve store efficiency and performance.
value_narrative: Empowers service agents with real-time transcription and unified customer data to accelerate issue resolution, Reduces average handle time and agent training requirements, Decreases operational costs through automated knowledge surfacing and suggested responses, Improves customer satisfaction with faster and more accurate first-call resolutions.
google_differentiation: BigQuery offers a serverless, highly scalable data warehouse with built-in ML, allowing retailers to unify all data sources and gain real-time operational insights.

description_and_problem_statement:
Problem Statement: Frontline workers often face high turnover and burnout due to stressful work environments, unpredictable schedules, and a lack of support. They frequently lack real-time information to answer customer questions, struggle with inefficient communication, and feel disconnected from the broader organization. Limited training and difficulties in balancing multiple tasks further compound these challenges.

Description: These solutions help retailers optimize their workforce, streamline scheduling, and manage tasks more efficiently.
associated_horizontal_plays: AI -Your Business. Your Models - Agent Platform -Growth
key_personas: Chief Operating Officer (COO), VP of Operations, Store Manager, Chief Digital Officer, VP of IT/Technology, Chief Information Officer (CIO)
customer_user_journeys: As a store associate, I want to receive clear, prioritized tasks on my handheld device so I always know what to work on next and can manage my time effectively. As a Director of Store Operations, I want to optimize my labor costs by automatically aligning staffing schedules with real-time customer traffic patterns.
how_it_works_narrative: This flow leverages data from various sources in BigQuery, including foot traffic patterns from in-store sensors and sales data from POS systems. An Agent Platform forecasting model predicts peak shopping times and store section activity. This data is then used to automatically generate optimized staff schedules and task lists within a partner workforce management tool (like StoreForce or Zebra). An associate receives a notification on their device: "Customer traffic is increasing in electronics. Please head to that section to assist," ensuring staff are always where they're needed most, improving both operational efficiency and customer service.
value_narrative: Eliminates data silos by centralizing disparate data into a single source of truth, enabling real-time visibility into sales, inventory, and operations. This empowers leaders to make data-driven decisions that improve store efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance overall business performance while reducing manual data reconciliation and operational costs.
google_differentiation: BigQuery's scalable data cloud unifies disparate data to power Agent Platform forecasting, enabling optimized labor scheduling and automated task routing for your workforce.

description_and_problem_statement:

associated_horizontal_plays: AI -Your Business. Your Models - Agent Platform -Growth
key_personas: Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Technology Officer (CTO), VP of IT Infrastructure, VP of Retail Operations, Director of IT Operations, Head of Store Systems
customer_user_journeys: As a customer, I want the store to be well-organized, with products where I expect them to be, making my shopping trip faster and less frustrating. how_it_works_narrative: This flow leverages cameras in the store combined with Vision AI and Google Distributed Cloud Edge. As cameras scan the aisles, the AI models—running in real-time on GDC Edge—compare the shelf layout against the master planogram data stored in BigQuery. When the AI detects a product in the wrong place or an incorrect facing, it automatically flags the non-compliance and creates a task in the associate's task management app, complete with an image of the issue. This automates a traditionally tedious manual audit process, ensuring brand standards are met and improving the customer's visual shopping experience.

customer_user_journeys: As an honest customer using self-checkout, I want a smooth and fast experience without feeling watched or accused if I make an error. how_it_works_narrative: This solution uses Vision AI running on Google Distributed Cloud Edge to analyze video feeds from self-checkout stations. This provides a real-time security layer that protects margins without creating friction for honest customers.
